name: gt_nf4
caption: Published NF4 last-band G_t. Rows are embedding spaces and are not on one scale. Columns are families and are not averaged. Filled markers: published CI excludes 0. Open markers: the CI includes 0. OLMo DPO NF4 and Gemma IT have no last-band point in either space and are omitted, not drawn at zero.
alt_text: Four families by two embedding spaces. Each panel shows published last-band G_t with its interval. No pooled mean.
limitations: P1 reprompt of a tail, raw_bytes, local NF4. Native sliding attention was not measured. Last-band G_t is seed-conditioned ensemble persistence in one embedding space. The two spaces are not on a common scale and are not pooled. Families are not pooled. A CI that includes 0 is not an established sign. An unidentified last-band is not a sign flip and is not drawn as zero. INT8 rows are concordance, not a third headline. Provider non-determinism was not re-measured on these horizons. L0 is finite: 12 turnovers, 49152 tokens. S12 is a separate censored count through 4999168 original tokens, not a pooled rate and not a permanence claim. Gemma Base BGE is an identified negative. The Gemma Base Qwen-embed sign is not established. Cross-space sign agreement for Gemma is not identified. Lock-table n is not the 12W completer count.

units.last_band_G: L2-normalised distance gap in that embedding space
